title: icpw-1999-world-championship
label: “The Annihilator” Alan Soriano

won.source: The promotion's own year-end commentary, 20 December 1999, describing Soriano's best-of-three-falls win over Chris Kitching at an event called Bad and Nationwide II as the year's Match of the Year.
